SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_DATE, o.DELIVERY_DATE, o.TOTAL_PRICE, o.RECIPIENT_NAME, o.SHIPPING_ADDRESS, oi.ITEM_ID, oi.PRODUCT_ID, oi.QUANTITY, oi.PRICE, p.PRODUCT_NAME FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ORDER_ID, ORDER_DATE, DELIVERY_DATE, TOTAL_PRICE, RECIPIENT_NAME, SHIPPING_ADDRESS FROM ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = :1 ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC, ORDER_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= :2 ) o LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = oi.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY o.ORDER_DATE DESC, o.ORDER_ID DESC
SELECT ID, PASSWORD_HASH, NAME FROM MEMBER WHERE ID = :1
